categories_thin: Therapists / mental-health counseling: beyond a few Psychology Today profiles and one behavioral-health practice, individual clinicians rarely publish a business address, so this category is undercounted versus what likely exists.
General physicians: most Old Bridge primary care is now branded under Hackensack Meridian or RWJBarnabas (excluded as health systems), so few independent primary-care practices could be verified.
Med spas / aesthetics: only four identified; several more likely exist but advertise mostly on Instagram with no indexable listing.
Barbers/salons: Google Maps without a login returns only a handful of results per query, so Route 9/Route 516 strip-mall salons are probably undercounted.
Laurence Harbor: no group-B business there was listed; the area is roughly 10.2 miles from Milltown center and appears to be just outside the radius.
caveats: Old Bridge Township is a large, sprawling township addressed variously as Old Bridge, Parlin, Matawan and Laurence Harbor; entries keep the mailing town used by the listing, and Parlin/Matawan-address entries near Old Bridge Gateway or Route 34 were kept when the listing placed them in Old Bridge Township.

Excluded on purpose as chains, franchises or health systems: Supercuts, European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Sugaring NYC, Phenix Salon Suites, MY SALON Suite, Diamond Braces, America's Best Contacts & Eyeglasses, Kessler Rehabilitation Center, JAG Physical Therapy, Hackensack Meridian and RWJBarnabas practices, Beach Bum Tanning, Sally Beauty, GNC.
Jersey Strong and SWEAT440 were kept but flagged: both are multi-location brands and may fail the 'no regional chain' rule.
Phones come from whichever listing showed one (own site, Bing Maps, directories); several entries have 'Unknown' rather than a guess. No phone number was estimated.
A few entries (RJ Aesthetics, Black Velvet Hair Lounge, L'Soul Nails Bar, Dental Associates of Old Bridge, HER Heart, Thrive Counseling) lack a street address because the source did not publish one.
njtgo.com is a single third-party township directory of recent vintage; businesses found only there are marked 'one bulk directory listing' and should be confirmed by triage.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable (blocked/timeout) from this environment, so no OSM cross-check of amenities was possible.
YellowPages, Cylex and BBB search pages returned HTTP 403; Google Maps served a restricted 4-result view without sign-in, so bulk enumeration via maps was not possible.
The Old Bridge-Sayreville-South Amboy Chamber of Commerce does not publish a public online member directory; it would have to be requested directly (out of scope for read-only research).
Booksy and Fresha listing pages render results via JavaScript and did not expose business names to the fetched text, so those inventories were not harvested.
